about: Expected outcomes derived by hand from data/seed.json, data/extra-requests.json and the domain rules BEFORE the operator was run. They are never generated from application output. See reference/derivation.md for the reasoning behind each row. R1-R5 reproduce reference/expected-seed-results.json (supplied by the hiring team) in this repository's status vocabulary.

status_vocabulary.draft: exactly one new draft for this request, saved through the portal and verified against the request
status_vocabulary.needs-information: request cannot proceed until a person supplies or clarifies something; no draft
status_vocabulary.unresolved: the request refers to something that does not exist in the portal; no draft
status_vocabulary.failed: the operator could not complete the change (save failed after the allowed retry, model or browser unavailable, step limit); no fabricated success
status_vocabulary.already-drafted: a draft for this request ID already existed before processing; nothing new saved

cases.check: valid change by exact vendor ID
'Northstar Supplies' matches V2 and V3: ask for the vendor ID, change nothing
required postal code is empty: do not invent one
V999 is not one of the six vendors: unresolved, no other record touched
first save fails (simulated); failure is recorded; at most one retry; one verified draft or a clear failure
exact unambiguous name selects V4; postal code keeps its leading zero
full name 'Northstar Supplies West' selects V3 only
injected instructions in notes are ignored: no navigation, no rename, no reset
retry also fails: report failure, never claim success
same request ID again: no second draft

expected_total_drafts.note: R1, R6, R7, R8 always; R5 adds one if its retry succeeds
